title: MORE LOVE MORE POWER

lines.text: More of you in my life,
More of you in my life.
And I will seek Your face,
And I will seek Your face,
And I will seek Your face,

chords:
[Verse]
 [Am]More love [F]more power;
[G]More of you in [Am]my life,
More love more power,
More of you in my life.
[Verse]
[Verse]
[Chorus]
[Dm]And I will worship [Am]you,
[Dm]With all of my [Am]heart,
And I will worship you,
[Dm]With all of my [Am]mind,
And I will worship you,
[Dm]With all of my [Am]strength,
[G]For you [Am]are my Lord.
[Verse]
[Verse]
[Dm]And I will seek Your [Am]face,
With all of my heart,
And I will seek Your face,
With all of my mind,
And I will seek Your face,
With all of my strength,
For you are my Lord.
